Mitchell, N.M. (2020). *Data Management Using Stata: A Practical Handbook*. (2nd ed.). Stata Press.

UCLA Advanced Research Computing. (2025). *Stata Learning Modules.* Retrieved from https://stats.oarc.ucla.edu/stata/modules/

*Note: *Recommended resources
UCLA OARC Stata resources: https://stats.oarc.ucla.edu/stata/modules/

I have used this source on numerous times. Even when you become proficient with Stata, UCLA's OARC Stata resources have been very helpful. If you just type *UCLA OARC Stata <enter your topic>* in a search engine, then it will usually pop up.

Statalist if usually another good resource when trying to figure out what went wrong.  If you ask as question on the listserve, you will likely be scolded by Nick Cox, or you will be told to "read the manual".  However, if you just read what others have asked, you will often find useful information.
